description:
Title: fz-kdt.48: make interned type identity denotational

## Goal

Make every type the compiler constructs correct by construction: within one
World, mutually-subtype denotations intern to one immutable `Ty`. Callable
construction identity, callable-set constraints, and observed call evidence
must be different typed data, never different interpretations of one mutable
arrow record. The result must remove compiler work rather than move it into a
second normalizer.

## Signal

- A typed all-pairs census over every interned arena in all 607 `fixtures2`
  sources has zero mutually-subtype identity excess. Comparisons use the
  World-lifetime operation-tagged `Types` memo; display/canonical strings are
  diagnostics only.
- Executable keys have no mutually-subtype input duplicates in the standard
  metadata-aware backend corpus and the retained target lenses.
- Exact activation inputs, callable surfaces, first-class publications, and
  no-wake/equal-publication behavior remain independently observable.
- Existing causal work ratchets do not increase without an explicit semantic
  reason. Behavior and artifact outputs remain exact.

## Strategy

1. Put structural normalization at the `Types::intern` persistence boundary.
   Collapse bottom; normalize list empty/non-empty membership and exclusions;
   reduce tuple conjunctions/subtractions to exact rectangles; use the existing
   `phi_tuple` decision procedure to prove actual widened rectangles; absorb
   typed-contained list, tuple, callable-surface, and callable-literal clauses;
   and re-sort only axes changed by normalization.
2. Make callable states impossible to confuse. Replace the mixed arrow record
   with `ArrowSig::Surface { args, ret }` or
   `ArrowSig::Literal(ClosureLit)`. The literal owns only kind, function id, and
   captures. A literal meeting a surface remains the literal; a literal
   excluded by callable top is bottom.
3. Keep evidence with its existing semantic owners. `World::FunctionRef` owns
   named arity. `CallTargetSummary`, exact activation-input rows,
   `CallableActivationInput`, `LocalCallableProducer`, and `CallableFlow` own
   observed or declared surfaces. Projections operate per DNF clause and never
   cross-pair alternatives.
4. Route closure resolution, contract application, RuntimeDemand, transport,
   and coalesced-call rebuilding through those typed owners. Coalescing must
   never replace a concrete activation value with its boundary schema.
5. Delete superseded literal metadata mutation, callable-value specialization,
   closure-surface variables/scanners, and the comparison-only type-renderer
   normalization/grouping authority. Remove all probes after recording the
   typed and causal measurements.

## Acceptance criteria

- Exact identity laws are RED first for bottom, list-minus-empty, posless
  list-top exclusion, disjoint list exclusion, tuple negative carving, nominal
  tuple hull safety, multi-sibling and partial-overlap tuple covers, callable
  top, callable surface containment, literal/surface intersection, literal
  exclusion, and closure-capture containment; all are GREEN in both relevant
  arrival orders and re-intern idempotently.
- Callable projection tests cover `literal | surface`, anonymous alternatives,
  and multiple DNF clauses without flattening or cross-specialization.
- Joined function refs, substitution, contract matching, runtime demand,
  closure calls, uncalled named values, escaped lambdas, executable inputs,
  interpreter, JIT, build, and AOT preserve their semantic answers.
- Full typed arena census: 607 sources, zero identity excess. No production
  arena scan, alias table, translation table, rendered key, raw-id ordering, or
  uncached repeated comparison is introduced.
- Focused suites, formatting, documentation checks, strict clippy, full serial
  library tests, and the serial fixture matrix are green.
- Measurement-only classifiers, diagnostics, adapters, stale comments, old
  tests/docs, and every other construction affordance are absent from the
  candidate.

## Neighbor boundaries

This cut fully subsumes fz-kdt.173 only if its anonymous-literal/surface
conflation acceptance is proven by the clause-aware evidence-owner model.
The paired activation-row persistence is indivisible from this identity cut
and overlaps fz-0za's literal/surface-blind row equivalence acceptance; resolve
that ticket's disposition when this candidate resumes rather than creating a
second row authority.

The current candidate is parked behind fz-kdt.214 -> fz-kdt.213 -> fz-kdt.165.
Its reached-leaf f98 RuntimeDemand work is 12 versus the authoritative 9 even
though the other two target readings fall from 58/63 to 11/36. The seven newly
walked formulas are the recursive reduce forwarding family owned by that
prerequisite chain. Do not re-pin 9 to 12; resume this cut on top of the three
owners and require f98 <= 9 before landing.

Fz-tfn.43 still owns interpreter fallback arity for pruned executable layouts;
fz-tfn.42 still owns return-payload type/demand; fz-tfn.45 still owns live
generated identity replacement. Do not silently absorb or close those tickets.

comments.text: DUPLICATE FOLDED (2026-09-03): fz-kdt.182 filed the same defect from the fz-kdt.120 research -- Types::union(empty_list(), list(int)) interns as `[] | [int]` though is_subtype(empty, list_int) holds (identical=false, is_equivalent=true, mutual subtypes), and fz-kdt.120's rule makes it visible (reduce at a ground reducer answers Known { result: [] | [int] }). Measured downstream at 0889c0b3a: activation keys carrying a `[] | [T]` union across the corpus: 1 at base (main/0#lambda@476-519/2[{any, any}, [] | [{any, any}]]), 0 under 120's prototype; render-identical duplicate executable keys 67 -> 40. So 120 does not need this first, but this ticket's "mutually-subtype types intern to one ID" is the general cure. 182 closed.
